courses.overview: 由跨國互聯、海纜與容量交易延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend cross-border interconnection, subsea cables and capacity exchange into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 海底電力電纜工程
related.why: IFA 展示海纜與陸端工程的整合。
related.transfer: IFA 展示海纜與陸端工程的整合。
related.difference: 海纜課著重材料與敷設邊界，IFA 另含跨國營運制度。
related.differenceEn: Cable study emphasizes material/installation boundaries; IFA adds cross-border operations.
practice: 把「歷史辨識」的概念圖與「海底電力電纜工程」的輸入輸出對照。
畫出能量與無功的不同路徑。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：海纜課著重材料與敷設邊界，IFA 另含跨國營運制度。
practiceEn: Compare the historical identity concept map with inputs/outputs of Subsea power-cable engineering.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Cable study emphasizes material/installation boundaries; IFA adds cross-border operations.

related.title: 紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例
related.titleEn: New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study
related.why: IFA 與紐西蘭都把海峽兩側的交流網經 HVDC 連接。
related.whyEn: IFA and New Zealand both link AC networks across straits through HVDC.
related.transfer: IFA 與紐西蘭都把海峽兩側的交流網經 HVDC 連接。
related.transferEn: IFA and New Zealand both link AC networks across straits through HVDC.
related.difference: 水力互補、跨國市場與既有極線年代不同。
related.differenceEn: Hydro complementarity, cross-border markets and pole eras differ.
practice: 把「兩端系統」的概念圖與「紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例」的輸入輸出對照。
比較假想熱阻上下界下的溫升。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：水力互補、跨國市場與既有極線年代不同。
practiceEn: Compare the two-end systems concept map with inputs/outputs of New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study.
Compare rise under assumed thermal-resistance bounds.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Hydro complementarity, cross-border markets and pole eras differ.

history.title: IFA 的工程年代
history.text: National Grid 區分 1961 年早期互聯與 1986 年 IFA；本課以後者及營運者公布的约 70 km、2,000 MW 系統為案例。
history.textEn: National Grid distinguishes the earlier 1961 connection from IFA in 1986. This course studies the latter and the operator’s approximately 70 km, 2,000 MW system.

history.title: 跨國共同營運
history.text: IFA 由 National Grid 與 RTE 的營運生態系連接英法電網；地圖標示英國端代表地區，法國端和海纜路由請查官方圖。
history.textEn: IFA links the British and French grids through National Grid and RTE. The map shows the British-end reference region; consult official maps for the French end and cable route.

roles.role: 經 National Grid Ventures 為 IFA 英方共同擁有者，可對照跨境互連與容量交易。
roles.roleEn: UK co-owner of IFA through National Grid Ventures, relevant to cross-border interconnection and capacity exchange.
roles.business: 英美輸電網營運與跨國海底互連（National Grid Ventures）。
roles.businessEn: Transmission-network operation in the UK and US and cross-border subsea interconnectors (National Grid Ventures).

roles.role: HVDC 海纜製造商，可對照本課的海底電纜。
roles.roleEn: HVDC subsea-cable maker, relevant to subsea cables here.
roles.business: 高壓陸纜、海纜、架空導線與通訊電纜。
roles.businessEn: High-voltage land and subsea cables, overhead conductors and telecom cables.

roles.role: 旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供 HVDC 換流站，可對照跨海直流換流。
roles.roleEn: Its Hitachi Energy unit supplies HVDC converter stations, relevant to cross-sea DC conversion.
roles.business: 日立集團母公司；旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供 HVDC、變壓器與電網設備，Hitachi High-Tech 提供量測與蝕刻設備。
roles.businessEn: Parent of the Hitachi group; Hitachi Energy supplies HVDC, transformers and grid equipment, and Hitachi High-Tech supplies metrology and etch tools.

courses.connection: 從「英法海峽 IFA 互連電網案例」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in IFA cross-Channel interconnector case study. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
